description:
Hi! I'm a first-year B.Tech Mechanical Engineering student at Government Engineering College Idukki. I'm interested in robotics, mechanical design, automobiles, automation, and emerging technologies.

I have a basic understanding of ESP32, robotics hardware, and programming fundamentals. I enjoy learning new things, exploring innovative ideas, and working on practical projects. I'm enthusiastic about teamwork and improving my technical and problem-solving skills.
